marketing_description: The DeWALT MAX XR Series 20V Cordless High Torque Impact Wrench features a 3/4-inch drive size with a brushless motor delivering 1420 ft-lb of fastening torque and 1900 ft-lb of breakaway torque. Designed for trade professionals, the tool includes a glass-filled nylon housing, a 4-mode push button switch, and 3 speed settings with precision wrench mode. The compact 10-7/10 inch overall length provides flexibility in tight spaces while maintaining durability for harsh environments.
